display_name: Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ): Self-Efficacy Score
description:
Mean of all items from the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) self-efficacy domain. The subscore quantifies patients' perceptions of how to prevent heart failure exacerbations and manage complications when they arise. This scale is not included in the summary scores. [Green CP 2000 (PubMed ID: 10758967)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10758967/)

[Search for all KCCQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=kccq)
